lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows within the central field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The high-luminance spots are positioned at the intersections of faint vertical bands and horizontal alignment axes, forming a structured lattice pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow immediately below it, extending from the mid-body toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, primarily concentrated on the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated teleosts (remoras) are visible trailing from the trailing edge and ventral surface of the pectoral fin and swimming along the ventral midline.
